_why: Strings the server ships in English ON PURPOSE. They render through T()'s fallback, so an i18n audit counts them as untranslated and can never reach zero — which is what made the count unactionable (release gap G7: nobody can act on a number that is never allowed to be 0). Each entry is a PROPER NOUN: a name a third party publishes under, or a wire/protocol identifier. Translating one would make it wrong, not friendlier. Add here only with a reason; anything else belongs in js/lang/*.js.

list_providers._why: The name the blocklist / routing-list is published under. An operator matches these against the upstream project.

fork_authors._why: The handle a turn-proxy fork is published under. These are how an operator finds the build on GitHub.

wire_names._why: Protocol and obfuscation identifiers that appear on the wire and in the clients' own UIs.
